# pai config

PAI settings: show, read, change

```
pai config <command>
```

PAI settings: show, read, change.

```sh
pai config path
pai config list
```

### pai config path

Print where PAI keeps its settings

```
pai config path
```

Print where PAI keeps its settings.

Print the PAI_HOME namespace dir and each resolved per-user file

```sh
pai config path
pai config path
```

See also: `pai config yaml`

### pai config yaml

Convert config.json to config.yaml

```
pai config yaml [options]
```

Convert config.json to config.yaml.

Convert config.json → config.yaml (and voices.json → voices.yaml), with a short
      # comment above every top-level section and any "_comment"/"_...Note" JSON-
      workaround key re-attached as a real comment. Verifies the generated YAML
      re-parses to the exact same data before writing anything; the JSON is then
      renamed to <name>.migrated-<YYYY-MM-DD> (never deleted). Every writer keeps
      working unmodified afterwards — see docs/config.md.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Print the plan without writing anything |
| `--force` | flag | — | Regenerate config.yaml (or voices.yaml) even if it already exists |

```sh
pai config yaml --dry-run
pai config yaml
```

See also: `pai config list`, `pai config path`

### pai config list

Print all settings (secrets hidden)

```
pai config list [options]
```

Print all settings (secrets hidden).

Print the main PAI config as YAML (secrets masked). Defaults to what the file explicitly sets.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | flag | — | Include every default value, not just what the file sets |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of YAML |

```sh
pai config list
pai config list --json
```

See also: `pai config get`, `pai config yaml`

### pai config get

Print one setting

```
pai config get PATH [options]
```

Print one setting.

Print one config value (dotted path, e.g. search.recencyBoostDays), masked if it looks like a secret. An object/array subtree prints as YAML; pass --json for JSON.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | yes | Setting name with dots, e.g. search.recencyBoostDays |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Print an object/array value as JSON instead of YAML |

```sh
pai config get search.recencyBoostDays
pai config get search.recencyBoostDays --json
```

See also: `pai config set`, `pai config list`

### pai config set

Change one setting

```
pai config set PATH VALUE [options]
```

Change one setting.

Set one config value (dotted path). Value parsing: true/false, null, numbers,
      [...] / {...} as JSON, else a string. Creates config.yaml (from config.json,
      if any) on first use, then writes comment-preserving.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | yes | Setting name with dots, e.g. search.recencyBoostDays |
| `VALUE` | yes | The new value |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | flag | — | Set an unknown top-level key, or a value of a different type than the default |

```sh
pai config set search.recencyBoostDays 7
pai config set search.recencyBoostDays 7 --force
```

See also: `pai config unset`, `pai config get`

### pai config unset

Reset one setting to its default

```
pai config unset PATH
```

Reset one setting to its default.

Remove one config value (dotted path), reverting it to the built-in default

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | yes | Setting name with dots, e.g. search.recencyBoostDays |

```sh
pai config unset search.recencyBoostDays
pai config list
```

See also: `pai config migrate`, `pai config set`

### pai config migrate

Move old settings files into the current layout

```
pai config migrate [options]
```

Move old settings files into the current layout.

Move config.json, workers.yaml, whisper-rules.md, advisor-mode.json, session-state/,
session-scan-cache.json, queries/, summary-cooldowns.json, work-queue.json,
kg-backfill-state.json, voices.json, the orphaned legacy federation database,
the legacy registry database, the legacy live federation database, ~/.pai/backups/,
~/.pai/obsidian-vault/, ~/.pai/scheduler-state.json, and ~/.claude/agents/,
~/.claude/commands/ into PAI_HOME.
The registry and federation databases each get an extra WAL checkpoint and PRAGMA
integrity_check (sqlite3 CLI, if present) on top of the byte-identical copy.
backups/ is copied and sha256-verified file-by-file into
backups/legacy-pai-backups/ rather than merged in place. agents/ and commands/ each
get a symlink left at the old ~/.claude path once their content has moved, so
Claude Code still finds them at its fixed harness paths.
Each file is copied, verified byte-identical, then the old file is renamed to
<name>.migrated-<YYYYMMDD> (never deleted); directories move their contents, then
the emptied old directory is renamed the same way. Idempotent — entries already at
the new location, or with nothing old to migrate, are skipped.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Print the plan without writing anything |
| `--logs` | flag | — | Also move ~/.claude/logs/workers into PAI_HOME: an atomic rename plus a symlink left at the old path, so any worker still writing there keeps landing in the new directory (falls back to copy+verify across volumes, refusing while a worker is RUNNING — see `pai worker ps` — only in that fallback case) |
| `--history` | flag | — | Also move ~/.claude/History/, agent-sessions.json, session-routing.json and history/security/security-events.jsonl into PAI_HOME. These are written by hooks on EVERY session's every turn, not just spawned workers — refuses while any worker other than the interactive session is RUNNING (see `pai worker ps`), but that guard cannot see OTHER interactive `claude` sessions on this machine. Confirm none are active (`ps aux | grep claude`, `aibroker sessions list`) before passing this flag. |

```sh
pai config migrate --dry-run
pai config migrate
```

See also: `pai config unset`
